pageTitle.text: 私密同步参考文献 — Keryx

intro.source: Create a private BibTeX link from saved paper metadata, then explicitly replace its references as your review changes. Anyone with the link can download it until you revoke it.
intro.text: 根据已保存的论文元数据创建私密 BibTeX 链接，然后在审阅内容变化时明确替换其中的参考文献。在您撤销链接之前，任何持有链接的人都能下载。

checking.text: 正在检查您的登录状态…

source.source: References come from this browser’s saved literature workspace. Personal notes, screening decisions and your research question are excluded. No paper is read and nothing is sent to a provider.
source.text: 参考文献来自此浏览器已保存的文献工作区。不包含个人笔记、筛选决定和研究问题。不读取论文，也不向提供方发送任何内容。

create.text: 创建私密 BibTeX 链接

reload.text: 重新加载我的参考文献

replace.text: 使用此浏览器的参考文献替换

replaceConfirm.source: Replace this bibliography with {count} currently saved papers? Its private link stays the same. Notes and screening decisions are excluded.
replaceConfirm.text: 用当前已保存的 {count} 篇论文替换此参考文献列表？私密链接保持不变。不包含笔记和筛选决定。

revokeConfirm.source: Revoke this private link and delete its server snapshot? Copies already downloaded elsewhere cannot be recalled.
revokeConfirm.text: 撤销此私密链接并删除服务器快照？已在其他地方下载的副本无法收回。

created.source: Link created. Copy and save it now; it cannot be retrieved again after leaving this page.
created.text: 链接已创建。请立即复制并保存；离开此页面后无法再次获取。

updated.source: References replaced. The same link now serves this snapshot. Refresh the linked file in your writing tool to retrieve it.
updated.text: 参考文献已替换。同一链接现在提供此快照。在写作工具中刷新链接文件即可获取。

revoked.source: Link revoked and server snapshot deleted. Existing downloaded copies remain.
revoked.text: 链接已撤销，服务器快照已删除。已下载的副本仍然存在。

secretLabel.source: Private bearer URL (shown once; keep it secret)
secretLabel.text: 私密持有者 URL（仅显示一次；请保密）

copied.source: Private URL copied to your clipboard.
copied.text: 私密 URL 已复制到剪贴板。

empty.source: No private bibliographies saved for this signed-in owner.
empty.text: 此已登录所有者尚未保存私密参考文献。

loading.text: 正在加载您的参考文献…

unavailable.source: Private bibliographies are unavailable on this deployment. Your browser workspace is unchanged.
unavailable.text: 此部署不提供私密参考文献功能。浏览器工作区保持不变。

invalid.source: Check the review name and saved paper metadata, or reduce the bibliography size.
invalid.text: 检查综述名称和已保存的论文元数据，或减少参考文献数量。

conflict.source: This bibliography or signed-in owner changed. Reload before making another change.
conflict.text: 此参考文献列表或已登录所有者发生变化。再次更改前请重新加载。

limit.source: This bibliography exceeds the storage limit. Remove a saved bibliography or reduce the snapshot.
limit.text: 此参考文献列表超过存储上限。请移除一个已保存的列表或缩小快照。

failed.source: The request could not be confirmed. It may already have applied. Reload to inspect the saved state; no request is automatically retried.
failed.text: 无法确认请求。它可能已经生效。重新加载以检查已保存的状态；任何请求都不会自动重试。

clipboardFailed.source: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the private URL manually.
clipboardFailed.text: 无法访问剪贴板。请手动选择并复制私密 URL。

boundary.source: This publishes a metadata snapshot only when you choose Create or Replace. It does not automatically track workspace edits or synchronize Zotero. Revocation stops future downloads, not copies already imported.
boundary.text: 只有您选择创建或替换时才会发布元数据快照。它不会自动跟踪工作区编辑，也不会同步 Zotero。撤销会阻止后续下载，但无法收回已导入的副本。

workspace.text: 打开已保存的文献工作区
